notes: Variant v016 is a selected unit over ἥν and leaves the projection unchanged.
The ASV margin 'putteth to the test' is not the text aligned here.
σύ is assigned to the thou of have thou, the imperative clause's subject; giving it to the thou of thou hast remains defensible.
ἐνώπιον is rendered by the single word before, which is therefore the head (rule 71), and θεοῦ stands bare, the ASV writing no determiner for it (rules 23, 101).
